name: Al-Shanfara
bio: Al-Shanfara was a pre-Islamic poet of the Azd. Al-Zirikli gives his name as Amr ibn Malik and notes disagreement about his name and descent. Accounts remember him as a swift runner and one of the outlaws whom their clans disowned. His ode in al-Mufaddal al-Dabbi’s anthology describes travelling on foot with his companions and pursuing a feud with Salaman. Tradition credits Salaman with killing him, and al-Zirikli places his death around 525 CE.
